messages:
Jordan (prod): Quick check — need final sign-off on GA readiness for inference launch: SLA tiers, escalation matrix, support runbook, monitoring signals, and pricing backstops. Who can own each?
Samira (eng-sre): I can own SLAs + monitoring signals. Proposed baseline: 99.9% p99 latency SLO for hosted, 99.95% availability for Dedicated. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Theo (eng-runtime): 99.9 p99 latency okay as a starting point. We should list allowed sequence lengths and model families per tier to avoid surprises. Also canary fallback flow needs docs.
Ravi (finops): Pricing backstops: we need clear burst caps + emergency rate-limits for pilot customers. How do we present deductive credits if we miss SLOs?
Jordan (prod): Good point. We should have a simple compensation table for missed SLAs and an internal escalation ladder. Ravi — can you draft compensation tiers?
Ravi (finops): Yep. Drafting now. Suggest: 5% credits for < 99.95, 10% for < 99.0 over billing month, escalates to account exec review below 98%.
Samira (eng-sre): Monitoring signals I want in the runbook: availability, p50/p95/p99 latency, token-generation error rate, queue depth, and KV cache hit rate. Also a synthetic ping per region.
Theo (eng-runtime): Also add model-fallback hit rate and autoscale delay (time-to-capacity) as operational metrics. If fallback > 1% for 10m, auto-rollback to smaller model and page oncall.
Jordan (prod): OpsBot — please attach the standard runbook template here.
OpsBot: Attached runbook template: /templates/ga_runbook_v2.md (auto-post).
Samira (eng-sre): For escalation matrix: page SRE first, then runtime oncall, then product/AE for impacted customers. Add severity mapping: Sev1 = total outage or >30% error rate for 5+ minutes.
Theo (eng-runtime): Can we add an automated fallback policy in docs? Example snippet:```json
{"policy": "fallback", "threshold_error_rate": 0.01, "action": "route-to-compat-model"}
```
Jordan (prod): Love it. Action items: Samira -> finalize SLO language and monitoring dashboard (due EOD Thu). Theo -> doc the fallback policy and canary steps (due Mon). Ravi -> compensation table + pricing language for GA page (due Fri). I'll coordinate final sign-off with legal and support.
Samira (eng-sre): One more: define customer opt-in for higher SLA (Dedicated). Need a checklist for provisioning Dedicated GPUs and contractual addendum.
Ravi (finops): We'll make a Dedicated SLA addendum template.
Jordan (prod): OK — if no objections, I'll send this as a short decision and owner list after the meeting. :thumbsup:
Theo (eng-runtime): No objections from runtime.
Samira (eng-sre): No objections.
Ravi (finops): 👍
Jordan (prod): Thanks — closing thread. Will post the sign-off doc shortly.
